mechanism: The declared window is72h, but retained v15 actually uses only its last hourly power mean and last observed10min power. Add ONE direct second-hour residual head to consume real72h seven-channel context. First-hour v15 prediction remains BITWISE unchanged. Not recursive: no actual or predicted first-hour target is an input to the new head.
features: 105 observed-history features: seven current globally standardized channels; current minus lag1,2,3,6,12,24,48,71h; trailing mean3,6,12,24,48,72h minus current. No future wind, operating-state labels or target values. Original hourly/target scaler fixed; additional feature scales fit only on each fitting prefix, with_mean=False.
head: Ridge alpha100 fixed, fit_intercept=False; regress (second-hour truth - frozen-prefix v15 second-hour prediction)/original target std. One105-coefficient head. No loss weights, alpha/lag/epoch/seed search, output or label clipping. v15 prefix experts and final expert strictly reuse cache and actual input/target identities.
partition: Same three purged chronological original-TRAIN origins70/80/90; each head fits only the available prefix, with fitting outcomes preceding the first query issue. If admitted, one final head fit on all original outer-train, then freeze before outer inference. No pretraining, no v15 refit, no Wiki.
selection: Second-hour MAE/RMSE AND overall MAE/RMSE must be non-worse than BOTH cached v15 and Persistence in EVERY training query block, tolerance1e-8. Mean second-hour error ratio vs v15 must improve beyond1e-8. Reject=>retain exact v15, no final fit and no new outer evaluation. Never use first-hour improvement to conceal second-hour damage.
budget: Only three fixed heads, at most one final head if admitted, at most one outer report. No additional candidates/folds/seeds. CPU only, own BLAS/OpenMP2threads; no CUDA or modifications to other users' processes.
primary_success: If admitted, second-hour MAE AND RMSE both improve over v15 and Persistence on unchanged outer cohort, with first-hour predictions exactly equal v15. Report both horizons separately plus overall MSE/R2/Skill/capacity hits and paired time-block CI/Newey-West. Historic outer periods already inspected; this is development, not independent confirmation.
limitations: Historical Ridge77 failed when directly predicting Persistence innovations; this is a distinct baseline-bound H2 residual/72h feature experiment, not guaranteed improvement. Measured old outer H2 weakness motivated the user request but does NOT set the new coefficients, penalty or selection thresholds. Future weather remains unobserved.
forbidden: using first-hour future truth at inference
